fact: The ministry page states that the Schéma Stratégique Intégré (SSI), the government roadmap that includes the National ICT Development Strategy, was adopted in 2014.

The African Development Bank's country strategy paper, dated December 2022, refers to an existing integrated ICT Sector Strategic Plan (2014-2024) that aims to transform Djibouti into an information society hub (document published 2023-01-01; statement dated to the paper's December 2022 date).
